sql:
SELECT
    p.PromotionCategory AS promotion_type,
    sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS total_discount_amount
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p
    ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE f.PromotionKey != 1
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY total_discount_amount DESC
